title: Count Vowels
description: Write a function that counts how many vowels are in a string. The vowels are a, e, i, o, u (both uppercase and lowercase). For example, 'Hello World' has 3 vowels.
instructions: Complete the count_vowels function so it returns the total number of vowels in the given string.
hints: Loop through each character in the string and check if it is a vowel.
The vowels are: a, e, i, o, u. Don't forget uppercase versions too.
You can use the in operator to check if a character is in a string of vowels: char in 'aeiouAEIOU'
